name: Chronexa Autonomous Outbound Engine v2.0
description: Enterprise outbound sales engine: webhook ingest → Perplexity intel → Anthropic bucket routing → bucket-targeted cold email generation → HITL Google Sheets queue. 9-feeder DLQ aggregates all data + infrastructure failure classes.

credentials.Perplexity API: httpHeaderAuth — Header Name: Authorization, Header Value: Bearer <PERPLEXITY_API_KEY>
credentials.Anthropic API: httpHeaderAuth — Header Name: x-api-key, Header Value: <ANTHROPIC_API_KEY>

replacementTokens.REPLACE_WITH_HITL_SHEET_ID: Document ID of the HITL approval queue spreadsheet
replacementTokens.REPLACE_WITH_HITL_SHEET_GID: Tab name or numeric gid of the HITL queue tab
replacementTokens.REPLACE_WITH_DLQ_SHEET_ID: Document ID of the DLQ failure log spreadsheet
replacementTokens.REPLACE_WITH_DLQ_SHEET_GID: Tab name or numeric gid of the DLQ tab

manualWiringRequired.description: The n8n SDK could not auto-wire 6 error-port connections during deployment. These must be drawn manually in the n8n canvas — drag from each source node's red error output port to the corresponding tag node.
connections: Perplexity Extract Triggers (error port) → Tag Perplexity API Failure
Anthropic Match Routing Bucket (error port) → Tag Routing API Failure
Parse Anthropic Response (error port) → Tag Anthropic Parse JS Error
Anthropic Generate Cold Email (error port) → Tag Email API Failure
Parse Email Output (error port) → Tag Email Parse JS Error
Append to HITL Queue (error port) → Tag Sheets API Failure

dlqFeeders: PERPLEXITY_API_FAILURE — Perplexity Extract Triggers error port
PERPLEXITY_DATA_ERROR — Gate Error Check False branch (Node 2 emitted error key)
ANTHROPIC_ROUTING_API_FAILURE — Anthropic Match Routing Bucket error port
ANTHROPIC_PARSE_JS_ERROR — Parse Anthropic Response error port
CLASSIFICATION_DRIFT — Switch Bucket Router output 5 (Unrecognized fallback)
ANTHROPIC_EMAIL_API_FAILURE — Anthropic Generate Cold Email error port
EMAIL_PARSE_JS_ERROR — Parse Email Output error port
SHEETS_API_FAILURE — Append to HITL Queue error port
